questions.text: System Complexity Characterization: Provide detailed complexity assessment: Function-by-function complexity mapping; Frequency and criticality weighting; Complexity scoring methodology; User interface complexity.

User Capability Assessment: Document user capability evaluation: Current user credentials; Practical skills testing results; Cognitive capability assessment; Experience relevance; Capability distribution.

Gap Analysis & Bridgeability: Quantify and assess skill gaps: Function-by-function gap calculation; Gap bridgeability assessment; Training investment required; Alternative strategies; Risk assessment.
Training Needs Analysis: Demonstrate systematic training design: Job task analysis; Learning objectives; Entry-level assessment; Training design specifications.
questions.evidence_required: Training needs assessment doc, Learning objectives

questions.text: Training Design & Delivery Quality: Provide training program details: Instructional design quality; Trainer qualifications; Class size; Duration adequacy; Materials quality; Learning environment.
questions.evidence_required: Training curriculum, Trainer CVs, Sample materials

questions.text: Training Effectiveness Measurement (Kirkpatrick Model): Submit comprehensive effectiveness evaluation: Level 1 (Reaction); Level 2 (Learning); Level 3 (Behavior); Level 4 (Results).

Technical Support Quality: Document support infrastructure: Support tier structure; Response time commitments; Support availability; Multi-channel accessibility; Language capabilities; Support effectiveness metrics.
questions.evidence_required: Support SLA, Performance reports, Support portal demo

questions.text: Knowledge Resources Quality: Evaluate knowledge management systems: Knowledge base completeness; Documentation currency; Self-service effectiveness; Multimedia availability; Localization; Accessibility.
questions.evidence_required: KB access, Content audit, Usage analytics

questions.text: Knowledge Transfer Strategy: Assess vendor-to-client knowledge transfer: Progressive autonomy pathway; Train-the-trainer programs; Documentation transfer; Shadow training; Escalation reduction plan; Local expert development.

Knowledge Distribution & Redundancy: Assess organizational knowledge resilience: Knowledge distribution mapping; Single points of failure; Redundancy adequacy; Knowledge concentration risk; Succession planning.

Knowledge Documentation: Evaluate institutional memory systems: SOPs completeness; Troubleshooting guides; Configuration baselines; Lessons learned processes; Customization documentation; Training materials.

Learning Culture & Continuous Improvement: Assess organizational learning maturity: Repeat incident rate; Knowledge contribution rate; Training investment; Innovation rate; Retention of top performers; Knowledge loss events.
questions.evidence_required: HR metrics, Innovation log, Incident trend analysis

questions.text: Local Talent Availability: Analyze technical labor market: Required skills and roles; Local talent pool assessment; Hiring feasibility; Education infrastructure; Contractor availability.
Spare Parts & Supply Chain: Assess supply chain resilience: Component inventory; Local availability; Recommended stock levels; Supply chain risk assessment; Total inventory investment.
questions.evidence_required: Inventory list, Supply chain map, Risk assessment

questions.text: Service Provider Ecosystem: Evaluate local service capacity: Service provider landscape; Capabilities and quality; Capacity; Vendor relationships; Development strategy.
Technical Community & Networks: Assess knowledge ecosystem: Professional associations; Industry user groups; Online communities; Academic institutions; Peer networks; Community development plans.

scoring_notes: Layer 4 composite formula: Weighted average of sub-dimensions.
